name: Public Exact Fulfillment-Slot Latest-Recorded Capacity-Source Read
purpose: Return the structurally valid highest recorded capacity-source row returned by the injected read for one exact fulfillment-slot stream.

selector.capture: Strict exact own-data keys, no getters, symbols, inherited-only fields, extras, coercion or trimming. Reuse validateFoodFulfillmentMethod and the bounded unpadded reference rules established by FOOD-007D. Capture a frozen detached selector before database work.

dependencies: FOOD-005V fulfillment-slot capacity-source durable domain and canonical validator
FOOD-007D public exact fulfillment-slot capacity-source read contract and D1 interfaces
FOOD-007G public latest-recorded read semantics and separation of concerns
storageValidation: Require success === true and array results, zero rows -> not-found, more than one row -> storage-failure. Require exact own data columns, reconstruct the canonical durable value, validate through the fulfillment-slot capacity-source domain, and compare returned method/locationReference/windowReference to the captured selector.
highestRow: Validate the highest recorded row only. Malformed highest row -> storage-failure. No fallback to older valid rows, retry, exact selected revision lookup or backward scan.
failures: Prepare/bind/all exceptions, unsuccessful or malformed envelope, malformed highest row, unexpected row count or returned stream-identity mismatch -> storage-failure, never not-found.
ownership: Capture a detached frozen selector before await. Canonical validator detaches/freezes the durable value and freeze the result. Do not freeze or mutate caller, database or storage rows.
safeClaim: A structurally valid highest-revision fulfillment-slot capacity-source assertion returned by the injected database read for the requested exact slot stream was obtained.
sessionCaveat: Conditional on injected database/session semantics; no globally freshest-state guarantee or perpetual authority. A later revision may be appended immediately after the read.
invariants: latest stored slot revision != current slot availability
latest stored slot revision != remaining slot capacity
reservationBoundary: This unit does not read food_capacity_reservations, food_capacity_reservation_lines or food_fulfillment_slot_reservations and does not compute remaining capacity or active commitments.
crossRevisionBoundary: A later slot source revision does not by itself define whether historical reservation commitments roll forward into that revision. FOOD-007H does not solve that accounting policy.
sideEffects: Read-only server-library export. No route, reservation-table access, SKU access, writes, clocks, network, environment, randomness, acceptance or migration access.
